events.title: Bernard of Clairvaux preaches the Second Crusade at Vézelay
events.description: Bernard's sermon on a hillside at Vézelay moved Louis VII and crowds of nobles to take the cross after the fall of Edessa. The crusade ended in failure before Damascus in 1148.
events.html: Bernard's sermon on a hillside at Vézelay moved Louis VII and crowds of nobles to take the cross after the fall of Edessa. The crusade ended in failure before Damascus in 1148.

events.title: Saladin arrests the leaders of a pro-Fatimid conspiracy in Cairo
events.description: Saladin, the Ayyubid ruler of Egypt, arrested the ringleaders of a conspiracy in Cairo to restore the Fatimid Caliphate, which he had abolished in 1171; among them was the poet Umara al-Yamani. The plot is known only from sources favourable to Saladin.

events.title: Pope Gregory X summons the Second Council of Lyon
events.description: Pope Gregory X convoked a general council of the Church to discuss reunion of the Churches, a crusade to the Holy Land and Church reform. The Second Council of Lyon met in 1274 and introduced strict conclave rules for papal elections.

events.title: Ferdinand and Isabella order the expulsion of Spain's Jews
events.description: The Alhambra Decree gave Jews four months to convert or leave. Tens of thousands left, and Sephardic communities took root in the Ottoman Empire, North Africa and the Low Countries.
events.html: The Alhambra Decree gave Jews four months to convert or leave. Tens of thousands left, and Sephardic communities took root in the Ottoman Empire, North Africa and the Low Countries.

events.title: René Descartes is born in Touraine
events.description: The philosopher and mathematician sought certainty through doubt, concluding 'I think, therefore I am'. He also devised the coordinate geometry that links algebra and geometry.
events.html: The philosopher and mathematician sought certainty through doubt, concluding 'I think, therefore I am'. He also devised the coordinate geometry that links algebra and geometry.

events.title: Gustave Eiffel inaugurates his tower in Paris
events.description: Eiffel climbed the stairs of his newly completed tower to raise the French flag for the Exposition Universelle. At 300 metres it was the tallest structure in the world until 1930.
events.html: Eiffel climbed the stairs of his newly completed tower to raise the French flag for the Exposition Universelle. At 300 metres it was the tallest structure in the world until 1930.

events.title: United States takes possession of the Danish West Indies
events.description: Denmark transferred St Thomas, St John and St Croix, sold for 25 million dollars in gold. The US wanted to deny the islands to Germany and guard the approaches to the Panama Canal.

events.title: Lyndon B. Johnson says he will not seek re-election
events.description: In a televised address on Vietnam, Johnson announced a partial bombing halt and said he would not run again. Richard Nixon won the presidency that November.
